rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Enables video playback from YouTube and TikTok through a lightweight mpv player window with full remote control including play, pause, seek, and playlist navigation. Supports browsing YouTube subscription feeds, liked videos, watch history, channel uploads, and Shorts, as well as TikTok user profiles. Features smart recommendations that find and queue similar content, infinite auto-refilling playlists, audio-only mode, and multi-browser cookie authentication for age-restricted and private videos.
